entries.finding: MINOR (arithmetic_wording): correct option D stated AI = "0.125 FLOP/byte (2 FLOPs / 16 bytes per element pair)" and later "(0.125 << 9.75)". True AI is 2 FLOPs / (4-byte read + 4-byte write) = 0.25 FLOP/byte. Off by 2x. Roofline diagnosis (memory-bound, expected ~62 µs peak, measured 40 ms indicates implementation issue) unaffected.
entries.resolution: Rewrote AI arithmetic to "0.25 FLOP/byte (2 FLOPs / 8 bytes per element = 4 read + 4 write)" in option D text and "(0.25 << 9.75)" for the ridge-comparison; rewrote the top-level explanation to a clean canonical version that avoids the ambiguous "0.125–0.25" hedge and clearly separates A/C byte-count errors, B roofline-applicability error, and D correct diagnosis. correctAnswers unchanged.

entries.resolution: Rewrote option B into a claim about the CURRENT state ("the FX cache is thrashing on the present 8-shape workload; each of the 8 shapes is being evicted and recompiled") which is factually wrong given cache_size_limit=8 with exactly 8 shapes at capacity but not evicting. Uniqueness restored. correctAnswers unchanged. Top-level explanation regenerated to keep letter references aligned to the rewritten option B content.
